# ankra_helm_registry_credentials (Data Source)

Lists the organisation's Helm registry credentials by name, for an addon's `registry_credential_name`. Usernames and passwords are not listed. The counterpart of `ankra helm credentials list`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "ankra_helm_registry_credentials" "all" {}

output "credential_names" {
  value = [for credential in data.ankra_helm_registry_credentials.all.credentials : credential.name]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `credentials` (Attributes List) Registry credentials. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--credentials))
- `id` (String) Placeholder identifier for the data source.

<a id="nestedatt--credentials"></a>
### Nested Schema for `credentials`

Read-Only:

- `created_at` (String) When the credential was created.
- `id` (String) Identifier of the credential.
- `name` (String) Credential name.
